meta.name: Bottled Life
meta.description: While the world’s population continues to grow at an alarming rate, water is becoming increasingly hoarded and scarce.Bottled Lifedocuments the trend of the privatisation of water by focusing on the NestlÃ© corporation that is hoarding water supplies for profit and control across the globe. NestlÃ© currently owns more than seventy of the world’s largest bottled water brands, with annual sales of water alone totalling some $10 billion. But the company does not want to discuss this business. Management refuses interviews. Information is not provided. What entails is a revealing look at the schemes and strategies of a powerful corporation, in a time of water crisis and extreme inequality.
